title: RacketRetreatExtraction
description: Strict JSON Schema used as the extraction contract for `firecrawl agent --schema-file`. Derived from directory-schema.json v2.2 but stripped of all UI metadata. Captures ONLY data fields the agent should pull from a page. System/provenance fields (id, slug, source_url, scraped_at, needs_review, lat/lng, location.venue_slug, relations.program_slugs) are populated by our pipeline, NOT extracted, and are intentionally absent here. The agent returns `retreats[]` so a single listing page yielding multiple retreats is handled, plus optional `venues[]` for the resorts, hotels, clubs and academies those retreats take place at.

retreats.description: One entry per distinct retreat/program found on the page. If the page describes a single retreat, return exactly one item. Do not invent retreats.

title.description: Name of the retreat/camp/clinic. REQUIRED. e.g. 'Elite Mediterranean Racquet Intensive'.

category.description: Program format. REQUIRED. 'camp' = multi-day structured training; 'clinic' = focused/shorter skills program; 'social_getaway' = leisure/vibe-led (couples, singles, group holidays). A resort venue alone is NOT a category.

theme.description: Optional audience/vibe tags, independent of category. e.g. a 'performance' camp or a 'couples' getaway.

organizer.description: The venue, academy, or brand running the retreat. REQUIRED. e.g. 'Rafa Nadal Academy', 'Global Tennis Academies'.

description.description: Full prose description of the retreat.

coaches.description: Names of coaches / pros leading the retreat, if stated.

languages.description: Language(s) of instruction, if stated. e.g. ['English', 'Spanish'].

booking_url.description: Direct booking or info link for this retreat (a URL). REQUIRED — if no dedicated link exists, leave null and the pipeline will fall back to the source page URL.

racket_sport.description: Sport(s) offered. REQUIRED. Multiple allowed for combined retreats.

gender.description: Target gender. Default to 'mixed' only if the page clearly implies open enrollment; otherwise leave null.

level.description: Player level(s) targeted. REQUIRED. Use 'all levels' when the page says open to everyone.

rating.description: Skill-rating bounds, all optional. Tennis pages may use UTR and/or NTRP; pickleball uses DUPR; padel typically none.

ntrp_min.description: NTRP lower bound (common on US tennis listings).

location.description: Where the retreat physically happens. REQUIRED: country.

country.description: REQUIRED. Canonical English short country name (ISO 3166-1), e.g. 'United States', 'Spain'. Normalize 'USA'/'US' -> 'United States'.

venue_name.description: Specific facility/venue. e.g. 'Santa Ponsa Country Club'.

address.description: Full street address if available — used downstream for geocoding (we derive lat/lng ourselves).

sessions.description: Each bookable date range. REQUIRED unless schedule_notes is provided. A retreat brand often runs many sessions across a year — capture each. Use ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). If a date in a booking link or URL disagrees with the date shown on the page, use the one in the link (some sites render dates a day early).

status.description: Availability of this specific session, if stated.

price_override.description: Only if this session's price differs from the overall price range.

booking_url.description: Booking link for this exact date, if the page has a separate one per date (a 'Book now' link next to the date).

schedule_notes.description: Free-text schedule when concrete dates aren't given. e.g. 'Weekly camps, May–September' or 'Dates on request'. Satisfies the dates requirement when sessions[] is empty.

pricing.description: Overall price span for the listing.

price_max.description: Highest advertised price. Equal to price_min for a single price.

price_unit.description: What price_min/price_max buy. 'per_person' = the whole program for one person (no shared room involved, e.g. a clinic or day camp). 'per_person_sharing' = the whole program per person when two share a room ('pp', 'based on 2 sharing', 'double occupancy'); put any single-occupancy price in price_notes. If the page only quotes per night or per day with no program total, leave this null and explain in price_notes.

price_notes.description: Context, e.g. 'single occupancy from £5,029; early-bird available'.

inclusions.description: What the price includes. e.g. ['accommodation', 'meals', 'daily coaching', 'airport transfers', 'court fees'].

coaching_hours_total.description: Total coaching hours over the retreat, if stated. Halves are fine, e.g. 22.5.

player_to_coach_ratio.description: Players per coach, written players:coach. '1 coach to 6 players', '1:6 coach to player' and 'six players per coach' all mean '6:1'. Normalize to the nearest listed bucket; 8 or more players per coach is '8:1+'.

capacity.description: Maximum participants per session, if stated.

venues.description: Optional. One entry per resort, hotel, club or academy the page describes in its own right (its courts, rooms, facilities). Match the venue_name used in retreats[].location. Leave empty when the page only mentions a venue by name.

adults_only.description: True only if the page says adults only.

website.description: The venue's own website, if linked.

country.description: REQUIRED. Canonical English short country name.

address.description: Full street address if available, for geocoding.

racket_sport.description: REQUIRED. Sports the venue has courts for.

courts.description: One entry per sport (and per surface if several). Leave count null when not stated.

price_notes.description: Room or stay prices, if given, e.g. '3 nights from €519 per person'.
